name: New Hampshire WoodWorks
old_description: With our stock of locally harvested maple, oak, birch, and beech wood seasoning in the drying shed, it was time to start creating with it.
about:
New Hampshire WoodWorks operates from Northwood, New Hampshire, where it has been crafting wooden heirlooms since 2001. The veteran-owned and operated shop began with a stock of locally harvested maple, oak, birch, and beech seasoning in a drying shed, providing the raw material for its first creations.

The company produces handcrafted items including beehives, custom tarot reading tables, nightstand bowls, and a range of unexplained underfoot objects. Each piece is shaped from wood dried on-site, with the nightstand bowls offered in varieties such as sunburst spalted maple. The workshop focuses on small-batch, heirloom-quality woodworking rather than volume production.

Customers include beekeepers seeking durable hives, tarot practitioners commissioning reading tables, and gift buyers looking for distinctive wooden bowls. The custom portfolio also accommodates one-off requests for furniture and decorative objects.

The veteran ownership informs the business's emphasis on durability and craftsmanship, with the drying shed and local lumber sourcing cited as foundations for the quality of each finished piece.
